# >>> KLEE (symbolic execution tool) environment >>>
# KLEE 3.3 built from source with LLVM 16 and the STP solver (no uClibc).
# Installed to /usr/local: binaries in /usr/local/bin, public headers in
# /usr/local/include (klee/klee.h), runtime bitcode in /usr/local/lib/klee/runtime.
# Keep this block at the very top of ~/.bashrc: the stock .bashrc returns early
# for non-interactive shells, and these variables must be visible there too.
case ":$PATH:" in
  *:/usr/local/bin:*) ;;
  *) PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH ;;
esac
export PATH

# Public KLEE headers: makes `#include <klee/klee.h>` resolve without -I.
# /usr/local/include/klee is appended so that plain `#include <klee.h>` also works.
case "$CPATH" in
  *":/usr/local/include/klee:"*|*":/usr/local/include:"*) CPATH="${CPATH:-/usr/local/include}" ;;
  "") CPATH=/usr/local/include:/usr/local/include/klee ;;
  *) CPATH=/usr/local/include:/usr/local/include/klee:$CPATH ;;
esac
export CPATH

# Shared libraries for STP (and MiniSat) live in /usr/local/lib.
case ":${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}:" in
  *:/usr/local/lib:*) ;;
  *) LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH} ;;
esac
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# Toolchain used to compile targets for KLEE.
export LLVM_CONFIG=/usr/bin/llvm-config-16
export KLEE_CC=/usr/bin/clang-16
export KLEE_CXX=/usr/bin/clang++-16
# Where KLEE finds its runtime bitcode libraries.
export KLEE_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib/klee/runtime
# >>> KLEE environment end >>>
EOF

__klee_prepend() {
  # prepend a directory to a colon-separated variable, skipping duplicates
  eval "__klee_old=\${$1:-}"
  case ":$__klee_old:" in
    *":$2:"*) ;;                               # already present: leave it alone
    ::) eval "export $1=\"$2\"" ;;             # currently empty/unset
    *) eval "export $1=\"$2:$__klee_old\"" ;;  # prepend
  esac
}
__klee_prepend PATH /usr/local/bin
# Public KLEE headers: makes `#include <klee/klee.h>` resolve without -I, and
# /usr/local/include/klee lets a plain `#include <klee.h>` work as well.
__klee_prepend CPATH /usr/local/include
__klee_prepend CPATH /usr/local/include/klee
# STP and MiniSat shared libraries live in /usr/local/lib.
__klee_prepend LD_LIBRARY_PATH /usr/local/lib
unset -f __klee_prepend
unset __klee_old

# Toolchain used to compile targets for KLEE (only LLVM 16 is installed).
export LLVM_CONFIG=/usr/bin/llvm-config-16
export KLEE_CC=/usr/bin/clang-16
export KLEE_CXX=/usr/bin/clang++-16
# Where KLEE finds its runtime bitcode libraries.
export KLEE_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib/klee/runtime
EOF
chmod 644 /etc/klee-env.sh

for p in ('/root/.bashrc', '/home/ubuntu/.bashrc'):
    s = open(p).read()
    start = s.find('# >>> KLEE (symbolic execution tool) environment >>>')
    if start != -1:
        end = s.index('# >>> KLEE environment end >>>') + len('# >>> KLEE environment end >>>')
        s = s[:start] + s[end:]
        s = s.lstrip('\n')
    block = ('# >>> KLEE (symbolic execution tool) environment >>>\n'
             '# Keep this at the very top: the stock .bashrc returns early for\n'
             '# non-interactive shells and these variables must be visible there too.\n'
             '[ -r /etc/klee-env.sh ] && . /etc/klee-env.sh\n'
             '# >>> KLEE environment end >>>\n\n')
    assert 'KLEE (symbolic execution tool) environment' not in s
    open(p, 'w').write(block + s)
    print('updated', p)
PY
